Specification: This module specifies a simple resource allocator for a finite set of resources and a set of clients. Clients issue requests only when they currently hold no resources and have no outstanding unsatisfied request; requests may then be partially fulfilled over time, and clients may return held resources even before a request is completely satisfied. The specification defines two temporal system specifications with different fairness assumptions, and proves safety and liveness properties such as type correctness, mutual exclusion of resource ownership, eventual return, eventual obtainment, and infinitely often having no unsatisfied requests; it also includes a symmetry expression and a concrete counterexample value structure.
